descr: Boat tail bullet of Steinbock Precision. Length, base diameter, boat-tail length and G1 ballistic coefficient as published by the manufacturer on the Steinbock Precision website (one BC value, not split by velocity). The initial gas pressure is the rifle default, it is not part of the published data.
